json.title: JSON Formatter, Editor & Viewer Online | DevMaster Tools
json.description: Format, edit, validate, minify and view JSON online. Free browser-based JSON editor with syntax highlighting and tree view. No sign-up required.
json.heading: JSON Formatter & Editor

content.about: Format, edit, validate, minify and inspect JSON for APIs, configuration files and structured data. The syntax-highlighted editor preserves large integers, while the expandable tree view makes nested objects and arrays easier to explore. Processing stays in your browser.
instructions: Paste JSON or upload a .json file.
Choose indentation, then format, minify or validate the document.
Inspect nested data in Tree view, then copy or download the result.

faqs.question: What is a JSON formatter?
faqs.answer: A JSON formatter adds consistent indentation and line breaks so compact or irregular JSON is easier to read and edit.

faqs.question: Can I validate JSON syntax?
faqs.answer: Yes. Validate reports malformed JSON with line and column details when available.

faqs.question: Can I view JSON as a tree?
faqs.answer: Yes. After formatting or validating valid JSON, switch to Tree view to explore nested objects and arrays.

faqs.question: Does formatting change large integers?
faqs.answer: No. DevMaster Tools uses a lossless JSON number representation so integers beyond JavaScript's safe range are not silently rounded.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing, validation and formatting happen entirely in your browser.

yaml.title: YAML Formatter & Editor Online | DevMaster Tools
yaml.description: Format, edit, validate and view YAML online while preserving comments, anchors and aliases. Free browser-based YAML editor with no sign-up.
yaml.heading: YAML Formatter & Editor

content.about: Format, edit and validate YAML configuration files with comment-aware parsing and clear syntax feedback. Anchors, aliases and YAML-specific structure remain intact because documents are not converted to JSON. Processing stays in your browser.
instructions: Paste YAML or upload a .yaml or .yml file.
Select an indentation size, then choose Format or Validate.
Review the result before copying or downloading the YAML document.

faqs.question: What does a YAML formatter do?
faqs.answer: It applies consistent indentation and spacing to make YAML configuration files easier to read and maintain.

faqs.question: Can I validate YAML syntax online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Validate checks the document and reports useful line information for syntax errors when available.

faqs.question: Are YAML comments preserved?
faqs.answer: Yes. Formatting uses the YAML document model rather than converting the document to JSON.

faqs.question: Does the editor resolve YAML aliases?
faqs.answer: No. Anchors and aliases remain YAML syntax and are not flattened.

faqs.question: Is my YAML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Editing, validation and formatting happen locally in your browser.

xml.title: XML Formatter & Editor Online | DevMaster Tools
xml.description: Format, edit, validate, beautify and safely minify XML online with namespace, CDATA and comment support. No sign-up required.
xml.heading: XML Formatter & Editor

content.about: Format, edit, validate, beautify and safely minify XML documents while preserving namespaces, comments and CDATA sections. Destructive whitespace changes are blocked for mixed-content XML, and external resources are never fetched.
instructions: Paste XML or upload an .xml file.
Validate before formatting or minifying the document.
Review the formatted XML, then copy or download the result.

faqs.question: What is an XML formatter?
faqs.answer: An XML formatter adds consistent indentation and line breaks so elements and attributes are easier to inspect.

faqs.question: Can I validate XML syntax?
faqs.answer: Yes. The validator detects malformed XML and reports parsing errors without sending the document to a server.

faqs.question: Does the XML validator fetch DTDs?
faqs.answer: No. DevMaster Tools never fetches external XML resources.

faqs.question: Why can XML minification be refused?
faqs.answer: Whitespace can be meaningful in mixed-content XML, so destructive transformations are blocked when safety cannot be guaranteed.

faqs.question: Is my XML uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. XML processing happens locally in your browser.

sql.title: SQL Formatter & Beautifier Online | DevMaster Tools
sql.description: Format and beautify SQL queries online with syntax highlighting, keyword-case controls and support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite.
sql.heading: SQL Formatter

content.about: Format and beautify SQL queries, CTEs, joins and multiple statements with syntax highlighting and keyword-case controls. Choose Standard SQL, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server or SQLite formatting without connecting to a database or executing a query.
instructions: Paste SQL or upload a .sql file.
Choose the closest SQL dialect and keyword style.
Format and review the query, then copy or download it.

faqs.question: What does a SQL formatter do?
faqs.answer: It applies consistent spacing, indentation and keyword layout so SQL queries are easier to read and review.

faqs.question: Which SQL dialects are supported?
faqs.answer: The formatter includes Standard SQL, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server or T-SQL, and SQLite options.

faqs.question: Does DevMaster Tools run my SQL query?
faqs.answer: Never. This tool only formats text and has no database connection.

faqs.question: Does formatting prove SQL is valid?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting can detect some syntax problems, but it is not a complete dialect-aware SQL validator.

faqs.question: Is my SQL query uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. SQL formatting happens entirely in your browser.

markdown.title: Markdown Editor & Live Preview | DevMaster Tools
markdown.description: Write, format and preview Markdown online with a safe live renderer for GitHub Flavored Markdown, tables, task lists and code blocks.
markdown.heading: Markdown Editor & Preview

content.about: Write, format and preview GitHub Flavored Markdown in real time. Use editor, split or preview modes for documentation containing headings, tables, task lists and fenced code blocks. The rendered preview is sanitized and processing stays in your browser.
instructions: Write Markdown or upload a .md or .markdown file.
Use split, editor-only or preview-only mode while reviewing the document.
Format the Markdown before copying or downloading it.

faqs.question: What is a live Markdown editor?
faqs.answer: It lets you edit Markdown source and see the rendered result update alongside it.

faqs.question: Does the preview support GitHub Flavored Markdown?
faqs.answer: Yes. The preview supports common GFM features including tables, task lists and fenced code blocks.

faqs.question: Can Markdown run scripts?
faqs.answer: No. Raw HTML is disabled and rendered output is sanitized.

faqs.question: Are fenced code blocks reformatted?
faqs.answer: No. Their contents are preserved by the Markdown formatter.

faqs.question: Is my Markdown uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Editing, formatting and preview rendering happen locally in your browser.
